name: Sky Resort 2
source:
Sky Resort's reputation continues to grow... And it's all thanks to you!

Welcome new guests and show them to their VIP rooms, where anything lewd can happen. They're counting on you to have a pleasant stay! Will you give your customers what they yearn for?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017830/Sky_Resort_2/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
天空度假村的声誉不断提高…这一切都归功于你！

欢迎新客人并带他们进入贵宾室，那里可能发生任何猥亵的事情。他们指望你拥有愉快的住宿体验！你会给你的顾客他们渴望的东西吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017830/Sky_Resort_2/]Steam[/url]]
